lines.2: The Tsushima family was quite entertaining.
lines.3: I was glad I brought them into the executive council. I'd never get bored.
lines.4: As I was about to turn a corner in the hall...
lines.5: (She was laughing her head off in the college cafeteria...)
lines.6: (Was that woman getting carried away again?)
lines.7: (I wish she'd cut it out already.)
lines.9: Were they talking behind my back?
lines.10: (Her number-one ranking in the country was bought with her parents' money, right?)
lines.11: (I bet she's only athletic because she's doping.)
lines.12: (I dunno. I kind of wish she'd die.)
lines.15: The huddle of girls froze, then filed away from the spot.
lines.16: 「Oh, that's wonderful. I love that sort of thing.」
lines.17: My mock-exam ranking and athletic ability were both the real thing.
lines.18: That small-fry air about them was irresistibly adorable.
lines.19: If possible, I wanted them to stay as servile as they were now.
lines.20: I stand far above those ordinary little people and take what I please from them.
lines.21: It is only because so many lesser people exist that a single hero stands out.
lines.22: All right. Time to keep doing things my way this afternoon.
